About Lithoscript

LITHOSCRIPT
More about the project

Where it started

I designed these letters for a fictional village in a mountain valley. I started with symbols for light, water, abundance and strength, then used their shapes to build an alphabet.

I wanted the letters to look like something people might use for maps, signs, trade records and letters.

How it works

The five writing styles use my letter images. Selecting an ink changes their density and texture. The downloaded font contains that combination.

Uppercase and lowercase use the same signs. The Latin keys are a way to type the script, not translations or assigned sounds.

What is still unfinished

C, J, Q, numbers and punctuation are not mapped yet. V and W share a shape. I have not assigned keys to the circle-arrow or diamond.

I made the material effects digitally. I still need to compare them with real tools and inks.
